new.s: To which deity are the eight rock-cut cave temples at Bhairavakonda dedicated?
new.x: Bhairavakonda, on the Nellore–Prakasam border, has 8 rock-cut cave temples of Shiva (7th–8th c., Pallava style). They are Hindu, not Buddhist.
